shortDescription: Updates the advanced settings configuration in the ZIA Admin Portal

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: auth_bypass_apps
options.description: Cloud applications that are exempted from cookie authentication

options.name: auth_bypass_url_categories
options.description: URL categories that are exempted from cookie authentication

options.name: auth_bypass_urls
options.description: Custom URLs that are exempted from cookie authentication for users

options.name: basic_bypass_apps
options.description: Cloud applications that are exempted from Basic authentication

options.name: basic_bypass_url_categories
options.description: URL categories that are exempted from Basic authentication

options.name: block_connect_host_sni_mismatch
options.description: Indicates whether CONNECT host and SNI mismatch i.e., CONNECT host doesn't match the SSL/TLS client hello SNI is blocked or not

options.name: block_domain_fronting_apps
options.description: Applications that are exempted from domain fronting

options.name: block_domain_fronting_on_host_header
options.displayName: Block Domain Fronting On Host Header
options.description: A Boolean value indicating whether to block HTTP and HTTPS transactions that have an FQDN mismatch

options.name: block_http_tunnel_on_non_http_ports
options.displayName: Block Http Tunnel On Non Http Ports
options.description: A Boolean value indicating whether HTTP CONNECT method requests to non-standard ports are allowed or not i.e., requests directed to ports other than the standard HTTP and HTTPS ports, 80 and 443

options.name: block_non_compliant_http_request_on_http_ports
options.displayName: Block Non Compliant Http Request On Http Ports
options.description: Indicates whether to allow or block traffic that is not compliant with RFC HTTP protocol standards

options.name: block_non_http_on_http_port_enabled
options.displayName: Block Non Http On Http Port Enabled
options.description: Indicates whether non-HTTP Traffic on HTTP and HTTPS ports are allowed or blocked

options.name: cascade_url_filtering
options.description: Indicates whether to apply the URL Filtering policy even when the Cloud App Control policy already allows a transaction explicitly

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: digest_auth_bypass_apps
options.description: Cloud applications that are exempted from Digest authentication

options.name: digest_auth_bypass_url_categories
options.description: URL categories that are exempted from Digest authentication

options.name: digest_auth_bypass_urls
options.description: Custom URLs that are exempted from Digest authentication

options.name: dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy_apps
options.displayName: Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy Apps
options.description: Cloud applications to which DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode applies

options.name: dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy_exempt_apps
options.displayName: Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy Exempt Apps
options.description: Cloud applications that are excluded from DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode

options.name: dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy_exempt_url_categories
options.displayName: Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy Exempt Url Categories
options.description: URL categories that are excluded from DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode

options.name: dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy_exempt_urls
options.displayName: Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy Exempt Urls
options.description: URLs that are excluded from DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode

options.name: dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy_ipv6_apps
options.displayName: Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy Ipv6 Apps
options.description: Cloud applications to which DNS optimization for IPv6 addresses on transparent proxy mode applies

options.name: dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy_ipv6_exempt_apps
options.displayName: Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy Ipv6 Exempt Apps
options.description: Cloud applications that are excluded from DNS optimization for IPv6 addresses on transparent proxy mode

options.name: dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy_ipv6_exempt_url_categories
options.displayName: Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy Ipv6 Exempt Url Categories
options.description: IPv6 URL categories that are excluded from DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode

options.name: dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy_ipv6_url_categories
options.displayName: Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy Ipv6 Url Categories
options.description: IPv6 URL categories to which DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode applies

options.name: dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy_url_categories
options.displayName: Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy Url Categories
options.description: URL categories to which DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode applies

options.name: dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy_urls
options.displayName: Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy Urls
options.description: URLs to which DNS optimization on transparent proxy mode applies

options.name: domain_fronting_bypass_url_categories
options.description: URL categories that are exempted from domain fronting

options.name: dynamic_user_risk_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether to dynamically update user risk score by tracking risky user activities in real time

options.name: ecs_for_all_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether or not to include the ECS option in all DNS queries, originating from all locations and remote users.

options.name: ecs_object
options.description: The ECS prefix that must be used in DNS queries when the ECS option is enabled.

options.name: enable_admin_rank_access
options.description: Indicates whether ranks are enabled for admins to allow admin ranks in policy configuration and management

options.name: enable_dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy
options.displayName: Enable Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy
options.description: whether DNS optimization is enabled or disabled for Z-Tunnel 2.0 and transparent proxy mode traffic e.g., traffic via GRE or IPSec tunnels without a PAC file.

options.name: enable_evaluate_policy_on_global_ssl_bypass
options.displayName: Enable Evaluate Policy On Global Ssl Bypass
options.description: Indicates whether policy evaluation for global SSL bypass traffic is enabled or not

options.name: enable_ipv6_dns_optimization_on_all_transparent_proxy
options.displayName: Enable Ipv6 Dns Optimization On All Transparent Proxy
options.description: Indicates whether DNS optimization is enabled or disabled for all IPv6 transparent proxy traffic

options.name: enable_ipv6_dns_resolution_on_transparent_proxy
options.displayName: Enable Ipv6 Dns Resolution On Transparent Proxy
options.description: whether DNS optimization is enabled or disabled for IPv6 traffic sent via Z-Tunnel 2.0 and transparent proxy mode traffic e.g., traffic via GRE or IPSec tunnels without a PAC file.

options.name: enable_office365
options.description: A Boolean value indicating whether Microsoft Office 365 One Click Configuration is enabled or not

options.name: enable_policy_for_unauthenticated_traffic
options.description: Indicates whether policies that include user and department criteria can be configured and applied for unauthenticated traffic

options.name: enforce_surrogate_ip_for_windows_app
options.displayName: Enforce Surrogate Ip For Windows App
options.description: Enforce Surrogate IP authentication for Windows app traffic

options.name: http2_nonbrowser_traffic_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether or not HTTP/2 should be the default web protocol for accessing various applications at your organizational level

options.name: http_range_header_remove_url_categories
options.displayName: Http Range Header Remove Url Categories
options.description: URL categories for which HTTP range headers must be removed

options.name: kerberos_bypass_apps
options.description: Cloud applications that are exempted from Kerberos authentication

options.name: kerberos_bypass_url_categories
options.description: URL categories that are exempted from Kerberos authentication

options.name: kerberos_bypass_urls
options.description: Custom URLs that are exempted from Kerberos authentication

options.name: log_internal_ip
options.description: A Boolean value indicating whether to log internal IP address present in X-Forwarded-For (XFF) proxy header or not

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: prefer_sni_over_conn_host
options.description: Indicates whether or not to use the SSL/TLS client hello Server Name Indication SNI for DNS resolution instead of the CONNECT host for forward proxy connections

options.name: prefer_sni_over_conn_host_apps
options.displayName: Prefer Sni Over Conn Host Apps
options.description: Applications that are exempted from the preferSniOverConnHost setting

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: sipa_xff_header_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether or not to insert XFF header to all traffic forwarded from ZIA to ZPA Including source IP-anchored and ZIA-inspected ZPA application traffic.

options.name: sni_dns_optimization_bypass_url_categories
options.displayName: Sni Dns Optimization Bypass Url Categories
options.description: URL categories that are excluded from the preferSniOverConnHost setting i.e., prefer SSL/TLS client hello SNI for DNS resolution instead of the CONNECT host for forward proxy connections

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: track_http_tunnel_on_http_ports
options.displayName: Track Http Tunnel On Http Ports
options.description: A Boolean value indicating whether to apply configured policies on tunneled HTTP traffic sent via a CONNECT method request on port 80

options.name: ui_session_timeout
options.description: Specifies the login session timeout for admins accessing the ZIA Admin Portal

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: zscaler_client_connector1_and_pac_road_warrior_in_firewall
options.displayName: Zscaler Client Connector1 And Pac Road Warrior In Firewall
options.description: Indicates whether to apply the Firewall rules configured without a specified location criteria or with the Road Warrior location to remote user traffic forwarded via Z-Tunnel 1.0 or PAC files
